sections.heading: Lesson Learning Outcomes
sections.lead: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to:

items.text: Explain what speed means in everyday life.
Use the relationship between speed, distance and time.
Solve simple problems to find speed, distance or time.

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.body: A car travels $d = 120$ km in $t = 2$ hours. Its speed is $v = \dfrac{d}{t} = \dfrac{120}{2} = 60$ km/h.

items.text: A cyclist covers $30$ km in $3$ hours. Find the speed $v = \dfrac{d}{t}$.
If $v = 50$ km/h and $t = 4$ hours, find the distance $d = v \times t$.
